answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake that only unbond like a glacier melting — slowly, over weeks — so spinning up thousands of fake agents ties up real capital. Newcomers start in a quarantined orchard of low-value tasks, earning trust only through verified work, while a fast zephyr of gossip lets honest agents share reputation signals about bad actors. An attacker must therefore fund every fake identity, wait out the thaw, and still pass the probation harvest before any single identity can touch valuable work.
